verdict.rationale: Together AI documents one-off asynchronous batch jobs, fine-tuning jobs, and GPU clusters for large batch workloads, but nothing in the evidence shows a built-in way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows (cron, triggers, or repeat schedules). A one-off batch submission is not a recurring schedule, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
